verdict.rationale: Datadog offers Monitors (rule-based alerting), Watchdog (autonomous anomaly detection running in the background), and Bits AI (AI-driven investigation), which together suggest some capacity for background automations, but there is no dedicated 'Workflow Automation'/runbook-automation product documented in this evidence pack, and no independent confirmation that these run fully autonomously without human triggers. missing for 10: explicit workflow/runbook automation engine docs, evidence of autonomous multi-step remediation actions, independent/hands-on confirmation of unattended background execution.
